summary.text: Joseph "Jay" Kirkland IV is the Democratic candidate for the Georgia House of Representatives, District 27, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Lee Hawkins.
A business owner who founded a music education company, he describes himself as an education advocate and says he supports Medicaid expansion and updating the state's school funding formula.

paragraphs.text: Kirkland is also known as Jay, and Ballotpedia lists his career experience as working as a business owner.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a native Georgian, business owner and education advocate who lives in North Hall with his wife, a public school teacher, and their two daughters.
He said he grew up in South Georgia, trained as a classical musician, and went on to found a music education company that has partnered with dozens of schools across four metro Atlanta counties.

Kirkland said in the survey that he is fighting for full Medicaid expansion, lower healthcare premiums and prescription drug costs, and a modernized school funding formula so that growing districts such as Hall County receive what he called their fair share.
He also named government transparency and citizen input on surveillance and data centers as priorities.
